unit.why: A short anecdote, told by R. Yehezkel of Kuzmir, about R. Elimelech looking at his watch during the Keter Kedushah on Shabbat and later explaining why.

stories.start_quote: סיפר הה״צ ר׳ יחזקאל מקאזמור ז״ל
stories.summary_en: R. Yehezkel of Kuzmir related that R. Elimelech looked at his watch while reciting the Keter Kedushah on Shabbat, and later explained that he felt such great sweetness that he feared his soul would expire, so he fixed his gaze on a physical object to keep his soul in his body.
